alex: Quick follow-up on the service-debt tiling RFC I posted — thinking about a trimmed approach to break the Enricher into adapter + core, but want to lock down rollouts and safety nets before we start. main concerns: schema drift, duplicated traffic, and telemetry blind spots. PTAL and reactions please :eyes:\nsara: SG. My main ask is we codify contract tests and an observability shim before cutover. otherwise we'll get weird silently-failing enrichments.\njordan: agree. propose the following lightweight plan: 1) add contract tests in CI that run against a golden fixture 2) put a per-tenant feature-flag gate 3) gradual traffic migration (5%, 20%, 100%) with automatic rollback on error-rate or error-budget burn.\ntia: +1. specifics on metrics we care about: enrich_success_rate, enrichment_latency_p95, enrichment_consistency_score (new). also capture duplicate-write counter. canary window: 72h per stage.\nalex: good list. for the contract tests — I sketched a small harness:```bash
# run against adapter localhost
curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8080/enrich -d '{"id":"fixture-1","payload":"..."}' | jq '.result == "expected"'
```This will be part of the PR pipeline and gated.\nsara: about data duplication: we should add idempotency keys at the adapter layer, and a short-lived dedupe table in redis with TTL 30m. low-cost and effective. any objections?\njordan: fine. we should also expose a migration-mode header so downstream can be told to ignore duplicates during canary. header: X-Redwood-Migration: canary\nalex: noted. I'll draft the feature-flag config and migration checklist. rough feature flag YAML for ops:```yaml
flags:
  enricher_adapter_split:
    default: false
    rollout:
      - pct: 5
        duration: 72h
      - pct: 20
        duration: 72h
      - pct: 100
        duration: 24h
```
tia: +1. add alerts:
- alert: EnricherErrorRateHigh
  expr: sum(rate(enricher_errors[5m])) / sum(rate(enricher_requests[5m])) > 0.01
- alert: EnricherLatencyP95
  expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(enricher_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le)) > 0.8\nsara: owners and action items?\nalex: owners: adapter PR - @jordan, contract tests - @sara, feature flag + rollout plan - @alex, infra changes (redis TTL + metrics) - @tia. target: draft PRs by EOD Friday, canary kickoff next Tue.\ninfra-bot: deploy-check: All CI checks passing for branch feature/enricher-split (7/7). :white_check_mark:\njordan: I'll open the adapter PR today. tagging infra for the redis provisioning ticket.\nsara: I'll author the contract test harness and add it to the pipeline.\ntia: will add metrics and dashboards — ETA Monday.\nalex: thanks all. if no blockers I'll merge the RFC addendum with these guardrails tomorrow. :thumbsup:
